outcomes.statement: Evaluate the quality of evidence supporting a causal claim.
Design a feasible investigation and justify its limitations.
Use generative AI to generate alternatives, verify claims, and document decisions responsibly.

modules.title: Transfer, synthesis, and decision defense
modules.formative_evidence: changed-case design memo and verification audit
modules.feedback: peer comparison and instructor synthesis before final defense

assessments.title: Evidence critique
assessments.ai_status: prohibited for first attempt; permitted for correction with disclosure

assessments.title: Investigation proposal
assessments.ai_status: permitted for alternatives and critique; verification required

independent_evidence.observation: An instructor presents each student with a previously unseen changed case and asks individual follow-up questions about causal evidence and the proposed investigation.
independent_evidence.evidence: The instructor records rubric ratings and short response notes for evidence evaluation, investigation design, and justified limitations.
independent_evidence.conditions: During the defense students respond without AI or peer assistance. Approved assistive technology and an equivalent individual written defense preserve the same reasoning criteria.

access.materials: accessible HTML and downloadable PDF; captions/transcripts
access.technology_fallback: institutional tool or equivalent non-AI workflow

evaluation.learning: anchored common items and novel transfer task
